decision: The competitor (Visa Cash App RB F1 Team) is fined €10,000.
fact: Late attendance of the National Anthem.
offence: Breach of Article 19.4 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards received a report from the Media Delegate that the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda) was late for the National Anthem. The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that the driver was indeed late for the anthem. The team stated that they failed to inform the driver about the timing adequately and therefore caused the delay, but it is also the responsibility of the driver to arrive in time. It is noted that the driver, once made aware of his mistake, took every reasonable effort to attend the National Anthem as soon as possible. The Stewards acknowledge that attending the National Anthem is an important element of the pre-race procedures and a sign of respect for the host country of the event. The Stewards note that the precedents are implying a less severe penalty (reprimand), but feel that escalating the penalty to a fine is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
title: Infringement Car 22 Late Attendance Of National Anthem
